title: Consent record for a voluntarily recorded speaker (docs/CONSENTED_RECORDING_PLAN.md)
description: Stored separately from audio. Contains NO name, phone, e-mail, address, national id, exact birth date, precise location, IP address or device identifier. The link to a reachable person (for withdrawal) is a random withdrawal token held by the speaker; the project keeps only its sha256.

consent_id.description: random, issued at consent time; printed for the speaker

speaker_pseudonym.description: random; the manifest speaker id; never derived from identity

form_sha256.description: hash of the exact consent text shown

adult_confirmed.description: speaker confirmed age >= 18; minors are not recorded

evaluation.description: use in privacy/intelligibility evaluation of the anonymizer

commercial_ml_training.description: use to train models that ship in a commercial product; requires ml_training

audio_redistribution.description: share raw audio outside the project (default false)

listening_tests.description: play anonymised outputs to paid/volunteer listeners

collector.description: collection campaign id, not a person
